title: NuGet repository settings
description: The nuget member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

deleteMode.title: Delete mode
deleteMode.description: What the protocol DELETE of a package does: unlist keeps the version in the flat container and downloadable, delete removes it and writes its tombstone. A delete through the management API, the UI or /files/ is always a hard delete.

forwardSearch.title: Forward search
forwardSearch.description: Forward the search and autocomplete requests of this remote to the upstream's search resource. false answers from the packages the remote has cached.

vulnerabilityInfo.title: Vulnerability information
vulnerabilityInfo.description: The vulnerability information of the service index: local lists VulnerabilityInfo/6.7.0 and serves trove's own NuGet advisory data while that data is complete (every class; answers like off while vulnerabilities.enabled is false); off lists nothing. Left out, the mode is local while vulnerabilities.enabled is true and the OSV source is not off, else off. The pass-through of the upstream's information, upstream, is not offered yet and is refused.
